newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet prices dip with NYMEX, diffs end mixed.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet prices dip with NYMEX, diffs end mixed.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices slipped lower Friday in very thin market activity, though differentials were mixed by late trade.
NYMEX heating oil prices fell 0.82 cent following the builds in distillate stocks in the American Petroleum Institute and Energy Information Administration reports.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade jet fuel was offered at 2.25 cents over the screen, up about 0.25 cent on the day.
However, U.S. Gulf 54-grade was offered at 1.75 cents under the screen, a decline of nearly 0.50 cent from Thursday's levels, traders said.
